Name: Simple Irrigation System
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds the following [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url] objects using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]:

[list]
[*][b]Bronze Water Pump[/b] - uses 2 electricity, outputs 10 water, crafting recipe learned at Farming 2. Must be placed in water.
[*][b]Steel [/b][b]Water Pump[/b] - uses 4 electricity, outputs 25 water, crafting recipe learned at Farming 4. Must be placed in water.
[*][b]Gold Water Pump[/b] - uses 8 electricity, outputs 80 water, crafting recipe learned at Farming 6. Placed on land.
[*][b]Iridium Water Pump[/b] - uses 16 electricity, outputs 200 water, crafting recipe learned at Farming 8. Placed on land.
[/list]
It also sets sprinklers to require water and power as follows:

[list]
[*][b]Sprinkler[/b] - requires 1 water
[*][b]Quality Sprinkler[/b] - requires 2 water
[*][b]Iridium Sprinkler[/b] - requires 6 water and 2 electricity
[/list]
This mod requires the following mods to work:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10197]Utility Grid[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[/list]
It is meant to be used with an electricity mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10199/]Simple Electricity System[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
